name: 3-D Skramble
summary: “3-D Skramble” is a high-octane flying mission across the dangerous surface of an alien planet. Unlike the classic “Scramble,” which is played from a side view, this version features an isometric perspective similar to “Zaxxon,” adding a new layer of depth to the gameplay. You pilot a spacecraft, dodging obstacles, shooting enemies, or dropping bombs on ground targets – all while keeping a close eye on your fuel gauge. Bomb fuel canisters to stay airborne. When one player loses a life, the other takes over – making “3-D Skramble” an exciting turn-based challenge for two.
